# Laravel Favicon Generator

> Laravel package by Infernal Média that generates a complete favicon set (ICO, PNG, SVG, Apple touch icon, web app manifest) from a single source image, plus a `<x-favicon-meta />` Blade component that renders the corresponding meta tags. Maintained fork of blockpoint/laravel-favicon-generator.

## Requirements

- PHP 8.3+, Laravel 12 or 13
- GD or Imagick extension (Imagick preferred for quality, GD fallback)
- intervention/image v4, spatie/laravel-package-tools v1.93+

## Install & usage

- Install: `composer require infernalmedia/laravel-favicon-generator`
- Generate: `php artisan favicon:generate path/to/source.png` (options: `--force`, `--name`, `--short-name`, `--theme-color`, `--background-color`)
- Meta tags: add `<x-favicon-meta />` inside `<head>`
- Output directory defaults to `public/favicon`, configurable via `favicon-generator.output_path`
- Publish config: `php artisan vendor:publish --tag="favicon-generator-config"`
- Publish views: `php artisan vendor:publish --tag="favicon-generator-views"`
- Programmatic: `(new InfernalMedia\LaravelFaviconGenerator\LaravelFaviconGenerator)->generate($path, $manifestOptions)`

## Generated files

- `favicon.ico` (16/32/48), `favicon-96x96.png`, `favicon.svg`, `apple-touch-icon.png` (180), `web-app-manifest-{192,512}x{192,512}.png`, `site.webmanifest`
